answer: A sponsor holds three vouch slots backed by a 70 bond. An applicant files an onyx seal binding both keys on the umber ledger: one seal, one identity. Each epoch the sponsor sends a signed pulse, replayed by an auditor. Silence or a copied seal burns bond and slot for 20 epochs. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented sponsors fail: one key, three slots. Honest pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
